State Tax officer of GST, Chennai ('STO, Chennai') issued Show Cause Notices (SCN) proposing tax demand along with interest and penalty on the issue pertaining to 'Classification of tractors' for the Financial Years 2018-19, 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24. Being a SCN and considering the merits of this matter there would not be any material financial impact on the Company. Against the SCN, the Company had filed submissions before the STO, Chennai on May 22, 2025.
In response to the submission filed by the Company, the STO, Chennai, has vide its order dated December 29, 2025, dropped the tax demand of Rs. 43.25 Cr along with interest & penalty for the Financial Year 2018-19.
